description: This file defines the OrangeHRM BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing likes on comments within the Buzz module. It includes methods to list likes, add a like, and remove a like, with validation, transaction handling, and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing likes on comments in the Buzz module, providing endpoints for listing, creating (liking), and deleting (unliking) likes with validation, transactions, and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list likes on a specific comment, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a like to a comment, ensuring no duplicate likes and managing database transactions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a like from a comment, with validation and transaction handling.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Helper method to populate a BuzzLikeOnComment entity with request and user data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'create' method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method parameters.
